## How to Contribute

### Applying to Be a Contributor

To apply to be a contributor, contact the project owner via email:
<a href="mailto:ethankletschke@outlook.com">ethankletschke@outlook.com</a> and politely ask to be a
contributor and give a reason why you'd like to be a contributor.

## Rules for Contributing

### Opening an Issue

When opening an issue, please check if the issue already exists before opening it. Duplicate
issues will be closed and labeled as a duplicate.

### Submitting Pull Requests

> Pull Requests are locked to contributors only. This is for security reasons and
> because this is meant to be an application that's part of my portfolio.
> The project owner would be happy to accept you (within reason) as a
> contributor if you [apply to be one](#applying-to-be-a-contributor).

The rules for submitting pull requests are as follows:

1. **Never force push changes to any branch that isn't your own, _ESPECIALLY_ not `main`**.
  This ensures no broken code gets pushed to the repository.
2. **Make sure the changes are necessary or relevant to the repository.**
  This is important. Do not make pull requests for unnecessary or irrelevant
  additions or features. Any pull requests of this type will be closed, and the
  project owner will _politely_ tell you why the PR was closed.
3. **DO NOT MERGE BRANCHES WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR PERMISSION.**

Anyone who breaks these rules will be removed as a contributor from the
repository.
